description: The terminal UI served by ui-api (remote origin). Added at runtime by src/lib.rs for EXACTLY the configured ui_url origin (__UI_ORIGIN__, default http://127.0.0.1:8010; no localhost alias: the shell canonicalizes an alias spelling before it loads). Grants exactly the 9 contract-v1 shell commands plus window dragging for the overlay title strip (data-tauri-drag-region needs core:window start-dragging; internal-toggle-maximize = double-click to zoom, the standard macOS title-bar behaviour). No event, webview, fs, shell, opener, notification, autostart or log plugin permissions.
